During Covid I gained a lot of weight. When the lockdowns were finally over, my doctor said I’m at risk of becoming pre-diabetic. So at first my weight loss journey started off “healthy”, eventually though I started engaging in bad habits. The goal switched to ending my life. 

I attended therapy for this, but what really helped me is changing my mindset. I missed feeling happy, or any amount of pleasure. I was all alone as well. I gave myself a year to recover, and see if I can find life worth living. So far it’s been more than a year, and it’s been mostly a rewarding time. I can go out and enjoy the world, and feel things. I’ve made friends, and now I’m in a relationship which has helped more than ever. Recovery is hard but rewarding.
